documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 with consolidated income of INR135.57 crores, representing a growth of 79.91% year-on-year. Management highlighted robust order inflows of INR209.24 crores across 11 orders during the first half, taking the total order book to over INR565.80 crores. The company expects full-year FY27 revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores, with PAT margins projected in the range of 9% to 12%. Operations at the new Kannur manufacturing facility are ramping up well, contributing to expected peak revenues of up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores next year. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for H1 FY27, driven by healthy order book execution and robust end-market demand.

guidance.claim: The company expects full year FY27 revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: The closing order book by the end of the year is expected to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: PAT margins are expected to be maintained between 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Year-on-year revenue increase is projected at a minimum of 30%.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand environment is very good due to interest in expanding the transmission network.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, now the demand environment is very good and the sector is also very good.

demand_outlook.claim: Market information indicates good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging as the company continues to progress in line with its targets for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflow remained healthy during the first half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that transformer demand is very high and expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand conditions are noted to be good both in India and globally across the globe.
demand_outlook.quote: And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects peak revenue from both plants combined to be INR550 crores to INR600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its geographic presence into Maharashtra during the period.
capex_expansion.quote: We also expanded our geographic presence into Maharashtra, further broadening our customer and market base.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter, bringing total capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capex for tank manufacturing facilities is around INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses to protect against raw material price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed pressure in H1 FY27 due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses to provide protection against significant raw material price movements.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: Management remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix, and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 17.42% and Net Profit margin was 10.07% during H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.42%, while Net Profit margin was 10.07% during the period.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 80% to 85% of held orders are covered with a price variation clause to absorb raw material price rises.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefits increased due to deploying more than 250 people for the new plant.
margins_costs.quote: So now we have deployed more people for the new unit. So naturally, the employee benefits will high.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: The product mix of the order book consists of distribution transformers at 16% to 17%, power transformers at 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers at 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr in the first half, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The additional capacity from the Kannur facility is expected to support order execution and enable participation in larger transformer opportunities.
orders_capacity.quote: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% and nongovernment orders represent approximately 69.9% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91% of the order book, followed by distribution transformers at 17.84% and inverter duty transformers at 5.25%.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%. This is followed by distribution transformers at INR105.27 crores, representing 17.84% and inverter duty transformer at INR30.96 crores, representing 5.25%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approached banks for higher working capital limits.
capital_allocation.quote: Now we have approached the banks for higher limits.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price movements can impact margins due to timing differences between input cost increases and price variation clause adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve peak revenue up to INR550 crores next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are expecting -- actually in earlier calls, in next 2 years we would achieve the INR600 crores. But now things are moving in good direction and I think next year we can go up to INR550 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Cash flow from operations should turn positive in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, it should get positive in this second half.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to migrate to the main board in an appropriate timeframe next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we have a plan. In an appropriate time, we will definitely come into the main board.

management_commitments.claim: The tank manufacturing facility construction is expected to be completed before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: The order book is expected to be maintained between INR500 crores to INR600 crores henceforth.
management_commitments.quote: Maintained between INR500 crores to INR600 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
